Manifest.Name: Probably Automated
Manifest.Author: edward
Manifest.Description: Artificial intelligence? No - Apprentice Intelligence. Automation, powered by underpaid apprentices. Wages not included. Hire apprentices through Wild's network, write routines (filters, conditions, move / swap / use tools on items), and they work the morning or night shift; read their results in a daily report. Probably automated. Eight languages (apart from Chinese and English, translations are AI-made). No capabilities needed; disabling the mod leaves your items untouched. 能工智人自动化，交给牛马的工作可能是自动化的。雇学徒、写流程，他们替你上早班、晚班，次日看日报。
